sloka: इति शीघ्रं ततो गत्वा वानरास्ते महाबलाः ।आगतास्तज्जलं गृह्य समुद्राद्वानरोत्तमाः ।। ६.११५.१३ ।।
transliteration: iti śīghraṁ tato gatvā vānarāste mahābalāḥ ।āgatāstajjalaṁ gṛhya samudrādvānarottamāḥ ।। 6.115.13 ।।

translations.english: Then the foremost of the Vanaras, endowed with the speed of mind, with all speed went and got water from the ocean.
